📖 How to use

  1. Use ← → to move, ↑ to rotate, ↓ to drop faster.
  2. Clear lines — 4 at once (Tetris) scores big.
  3. Every 10 lines the level (and speed) rises.
  4. Don't let the stack reach the top!

❓ Frequently asked questions

What are the controls?

Arrow keys: ←/→ move, ↓ soft drop, ↑ rotate, Space hard drop, P pause. Touch buttons are on screen too.

How do levels work?

Every 10 lines raises the level, speeding up the fall and multiplying line-clear points.

How is scoring calculated?

Single 40, Double 100, Triple 300, Tetris 1200 — each multiplied by the current level.

How does the game end?

When a new piece has no room to spawn, the game ends and shows your final score.
